title: Voice control in the web workspace via on-device Moonshine
description:
As a human running a software factory from hey.chattic.us, I want to talk to my bots hands-free for as long as I like, so that I can orchestrate work by voice without paying for a live multimodal stream.

Principle: functional, cheap, intelligent voice control -- not a human impersonation. Listening, VAD, transcription, and common commands run on-device in the browser (Moonshine). Cloud/AI activity happens only when the user actually says something that needs a bot, and then it is an ordinary one-turn request.

Not included: a persistent audio stream to a cloud model, WebSockets, realtime multimodal APIs, human-like voice persona.
